tasks_completed.feedback: the dodge roll mechanic feels super responsive during boss patterns. wish there was a tiny vibration haptic cue when getting hit so damage taken is more noticeable.
checked out the seasonal mangoes section today and item specs load fast with nice pics. would be handy if expected delivery time showed up before adding to basket.
tried checking the iced drinks menu today and options are clear with nice photos. maybe add a sugar level slider for iced tea so you dont have to put it in notes.
group rules overview looks neat and member avatars make it easy to tell friends apart. maybe add an option to pin an address note for remote gift exchanges.
clearing number pairs with haptics turned on feels super satisfying. my only suggestion is an optional dark mode tile set for playing late in bed.
found some great philosophy quotes today and font rendering looks super crisp. adding a copy text button right on the card would make sharing with friends much faster.
got an idea for sketching outdoor stuff today which was surprisingly fun. a filter for quick 5 minute ideas vs long afternoon projects would make this even better.
root upgrade tree has tons of depth and passive multiplier numbers update cleanly. tree foliage graphics look sweet, maybe add night time visual theme too.
customizing 1k and 4k frequency bands helped clean up podcast vocals nicely. visualizer bars look great, maybe add an option to change bar color gradients.
dice rolling sound effects and board glow look very polished. an auto roll toggle for when playing against bots would make matches flow even quicker.
monthly expense chart makes it super easy to see where my grocery budget went. would be awesome to set individual spending caps for each category.
placing flags with long press haptics feels very tactile and responsive. board reset button at the top is handy, though an undo last tap option would be awesome.
